answer: Keep a public atlas of what it really costs to fake one passing identity. Red-teamers earn a bounty for each throwaway seat they push through onboarding, filing receipts for the compute, verification and stake they spent. The network then caps every new seat's per-epoch reward so its total over the vesting period stays below the cheapest proven cost, so a farm never earns back its build cost. Admission becomes a toll bridge, not a free pearl, and the cap rises only as cheap attacks stop working.
